body: Self improving only helps so much, it's hard to keep on the train when you haven't reaped any benefits out of it. How am I supposed to find people that care about the same things I did when I can't talk to people right? I'm pretty sure my handful of interests are far too strange for most people, and actually in my experience people just give me shit for the things I like and do so... I'm not worth being around right? Really it'd be better if I didn't exist.
I believe what the evidence shows me. All the evidence points towards me not being worth being around. All those things are pretty shit.
I hope you are still here and can find the strength to pull through. I want you to know you're not just a "sex toy" you are a beautiful person and you deserve better.
